[[Warchief]] '''Naloriss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] living in [[Kerritamba Village]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], [[Dahlia Damask]], leader of the [[Outcasts (Kashyyyk)|Outcasts of Kkowir Forest]], ordered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] exiled from Kerritamba Village to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Naloriss. She ordered this as an act of revenge and strategic weakening of the village's defenses. The spacer infiltrated the village and slew the Wookiee. Dahlia rewarded the spacer with 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Behind the scenes==
Naloriss appears as a non-playable character in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' expansion pack, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], released in [[2005]]. While the player may side with Kerritamba Village and never receive the quest to killed Naloriss from Dhalia Damask, he can still be attacked and killed.
